request: Analyze GSE132520 for PMID 34039988 (CaMKII oxidation is a critical performance/disease trade-off acquired at the dawn of vertebrate evolution.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk poly(A)+ RNA-seq, mouse quadriceps, NovaSeq 100 bp PE (S4.25.p1, S4.26.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: male mice 13-15 weeks; MM (WT littermate) and VV (CaMKIIgamma M281V/M282V knock-in); sedentary or single bout of submaximal treadmill exercise (350 m), muscle collected 3 h after exercise; mice not finishing the protocol excluded; n = 4 per group (S4.23.p1, FIG3 legend b)
final.primary_estimand: acute transcriptional response of quadriceps to one bout of submaximal exercise (exercised vs sedentary, 3 h post) within each genotype, MM (WT) and VV (S2.3.p1, FIG3 c)
planned_contrasts: MM exercised vs MM sedentary (S2.3.p1; paper: 582 genes q < 0.05)
VV exercised vs VV sedentary (S2.3.p1; paper: 216 genes q < 0.05, 180 shared with MM)
MM exercised vs VV exercised (S2.3.p2, S4.26.p2; genes over 2 sigma fed to IPA, no q-value count reported)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; independent mice, one quadriceps each
final.normalization: Tophat -> Stringtie -> Cuffdiff v2.2.1 FPKM (GEO data_processing)
final.paper_method: Cuffdiff v2.2.1 per-genotype exercised vs sedentary (GEO data_processing; S4.26.p1 defers to Tables S2-4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.3.p1 states 582 genes (q < 0.05) changed by exercise in MM and 216 in VV; FIG3 legend c defines the FDR-adjusted q < 0.05 rule with no fold-change cutoff. S4.23.p1 gives the acute exercise protocol; S4.26.p1/S9.p1 name GSE132520. The method (Cuffdiff) comes from the GEO data_processing field because the paper defers to Tables S2-4. The 2-sigma rule (S4.26.p2) only selects genes for IPA and is not the DEG count rule.

checks: GEO: 16 male quadriceps samples, 4 WT/VV x sed/ex, matches FIG3 b n = 4 per group
treatment_protocol matches S4.23.p1 (350 m submaximal run, 3 h rest)

ownership.reasoning: Paper cites GSE132520 directly; sample count, tissue, sex, genotypes and protocol match.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix column names equal the GEO title exactly (inspect alignment_keys: title 16/16). Genotype and treatment come from the characteristics fields; titles agree (WT_of_MMVVg = Wildtype, quad_ex = exercised). The numeric title prefix (e.g. 2161) looks like a litter/cage ID and is derived only for the confounding report.

final.paper_input: Cuffdiff on aligned reads (BAM), not deposited

matrix.reasoning: Values are non-integer (integer fraction 0.18 is zeros), range 0-28112, median 1.6; file name and data_processing (.xlsx file of FPKM values) say FPKM. No raw counts are deposited, so the Cuffdiff/count route is blocked.

final.analysis_type: multi-group (2x2 genotype x treatment as 4-level cell factor)

design.reasoning: The paper's estimand is the exercise response within each genotype (S2.3.p1, FIG3 c), so both within-genotype contrasts are planned and fitted from one 4-cell model on all 16 samples. The post-exercise genotype comparison (S2.3.p2) is run as exploratory because the paper only used a 2-sigma ranking for IPA and reports no count; the sedentary genotype comparison is exploratory (paper: PCA similar, FIG3 b).

candidates.value: pooled exercised vs sedentary across genotypes
candidates.reason_rejected: paper reports exercise effects separately per genotype; pooling mixes genotypes whose responses differ

candidates.value: two separate per-genotype fits of 8 samples
candidates.reason_rejected: one joint model shares variance across 16 samples; differs only in variance pooling, recorded as a deviation from per-pair Cuffdiff runs

covariates.name: litter
covariates.disposition: rejected: not in the paper's design, spread unevenly across cells (many litters with 1-2 samples), would consume residual df

covariance.reasoning: Independent mice, one muscle per mouse, no batch recorded in GEO or the paper. The title prefix may be a litter ID; it is reported in the confounding check but not modelled because the paper does not block on it.

paper_route.reason: only FPKM deposited; no BAM or count matrix in GEO, and FPKM must not be rounded into counts

deviations: limma on log2(FPKM+1) instead of Cuffdiff
one joint 4-cell model instead of per-pair Cuffdiff runs
low-expression filter FPKM >= 1 in >= 4 samples (stands in for Cuffdiff not testing low-expressed genes)

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: FPKM -> log2(x+1) -> limma. Cuffdiff cannot run without reads. A FPKM >= 1 in at least 4 samples (one group size) filter removes near-zero genes that Cuffdiff would not test; a no-filter sensitivity run is added.

final.deviation_note: Paper's FDR q < 0.05 (Cuffdiff q-value, BH) applied to limma BH-adjusted p.

threshold.reasoning: S2.3.p1 and FIG3 legend c: FDR-adjusted q < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff.

caveats: Cuffdiff route blocked (FPKM only); limma-trend counts are not expected to equal Cuffdiff counts
IPA 2-sigma gene lists and IPA pathway results are not reproduced

study.reasoning: Paper counts from S2.3.p1; the paper names no individual DEGs in the text.

discrepancies.data: 32 NaN cells in 8 rows of the FPKM matrix (one row named gene)

executions.name: main
executions.reasoning: One limma model ~0+grp on all 16 samples; the two within-genotype exercise contrasts are the paper's planned estimands; the genotype contrasts are exploratory.

executions.name: nofilter
executions.reasoning: Same model without the low-expression filter, to show how much the filter changes the counts.

enrichment.reasoning: paper reports pathway (IPA) results for the MM exercise response (FIG3 f)
paper reports pathway (IPA) results for the VV exercise response (FIG3 g)
